_comment: Source of truth for the curated SLO alerting system. Consumed by scripts/gen_grafana_alerts.py to emit Grafana provisioning payloads under alerting/grafana/. SEPARATE from the triage-bot escalation_score machinery. Design doc: references/architecture/alerting-system-design.md. NEVER put Slack webhook URLs or passwords here — webhook ids and datasource uids only.

meta.paging_target: slack-only for now. A Grafana 'XMatters' contact point already exists (webhook). Route P1 there ONLY after this system demonstrates value AND the user explicitly authorizes paging.
meta.grafana_url_hint: GRAFANA_URL may be a login page (…/grafana/login). The provisioner strips /login and auto-detects the API base (root /api vs /grafana/api).
meta.es_field_note: ES/Serilog: .NET Core services log severity in lowercase `level` (e.g. level:Error); older .NET Framework uses `Level`. Queries below use a case-tolerant form; confirm per index via `grafana_provision.py probe`.

queries.error: service:(ms-authentication-api OR ms-gateway-api) AND tag:auth AND (level:Error OR Level:Error OR status:>=500)

slos.probe_note: Confirm auth log fields/tags in applogs-es; sign-in synthetic (Datadog) is corroboration only, not required for this rule.
Confirm gateway status-code field name in applogs-es (status vs http.status_code vs StatusCode).
No gateway_metrics InfluxDB datasource seen. Confirm gateway latency exists in Prometheus (metric+labels) OR derive from applogs-es request-duration field. If neither, this SLO is deferred.

queries.influxql_p95: SELECT percentile("duration_ms", 95) FROM "rtc_request" WHERE "endpoint" =~ /screen|datatable/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m)

owner.owner_note: runtime-core split across 3 teams by host — see ownership_gaps; primary owner to confirm.

slos.probe_note: Confirm measurement+field in rtcapi_metrics (this is ki-24's RTC screen-load p95 signal). Placeholder: measurement rtc_request, field duration_ms.

queries.influxql_p95: SELECT percentile("duration_ms", 95) FROM "action_execution" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m)

slos.probe_note: Confirm measurement+field in approutine_action_metrics / rtcapi_metrics (RTC action-exec p95). Placeholder: action_execution.duration_ms.
Low-volume journey — absolute count, not burn-rate. Confirm designer save log signature.

queries.influxql_backlog: SELECT max("oldest_unprocessed_age_s") FROM "sync_queue" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m)

slos.probe_note: Confirm syncservice_metrics measurement+field for backlog age. Placeholder: sync_queue.oldest_unprocessed_age_s.

slos.justification: Cause-based alert, justified: F1 — when Subscriber stops, cache invalidation halts and users see stale screens for minutes with NO error-rate symptom. No symptom-level detector exists.

queries.influxql_lag: SELECT max("messages") FROM "consumer_lag" WHERE "consumer" =~ /runtime.core.subscriber/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m)

slos.probe_note: Confirm eda_metrics measurements: subscriber_heartbeat, consumer_lag (messages, consumer tag).

slos.justification: Cause-based alert, justified: F2 — async events dead-letter silently; AppRoutines stall with no edge symptom.

queries.influxql_dlq: SELECT max("depth") FROM "dlq" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m)

slos.probe_note: Confirm eda_metrics DLQ measurement+field. Placeholder: dlq.depth.

ownership_gaps: runtime-core is one deployable split across 3 teams by host (runtime-core-api->Vertical App Experience, runtime-core-subscriber-api->CRM Experience, designer-core-api->No Code Next Gen); a single pool-stop (F6) hits all three — needs a designated primary owner / cross-team bridge.
DevOps team has no TeamSlackAlertChannel webhook in the ownership grid — infrastructure alerts (Redis/RabbitMQ broker/ES/SQL/IIS) have no eventual team channel (the one true orphan).
Components/projects mapped to teams that do not exist in the Teams grid: Impact, Stock Apps, Internal, Logstash, and blank/Department (empty team row).
Vertical App Experience and Transactions share one webhook (B063S8NBW0M) — per-team paging cannot distinguish them.
ms-search-api vs runtime-core Method.Search alias ambiguity (already flagged in CLAUDE.md) — search SLI owner unclear.
